```{=html}
<section class="list-status-page">
  <div class="list-status" data-view="loading">
    <p class="section-label">Your Salem list</p>
    <h1 class="list-status-heading" tabindex="-1">Update your interests.</h1>
    <p class="list-status-lede" role="status">Loading your preferences…</p>
  </div>

  <div class="list-status" data-view="edit" hidden>
    <p class="section-label">Your Salem list</p>
    <h1 class="list-status-heading" id="prefs-heading" tabindex="-1">Update your interests.</h1>
    <p class="list-status-lede">Choose what you’d like to hear about. We’ll keep the rest out of your inbox.</p>
    <form class="list-prefs-form" id="prefs-form" novalidate>
      <fieldset class="form-field">
        <legend>I’m interested in</legend>
        <div class="interest-chips">
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="interest" value="Individual shirts"><span>Individual shirts</span></label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="interest" value="Team and group orders"><span>Team &amp; group orders</span></label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="interest" value="Church and youth events"><span>Church &amp; youth events</span></label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="interest" value="Fundraisers"><span>Fundraisers</span></label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="interest" value="Personal gifts"><span>Personal gifts</span></label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="interest" value="Other events"><span>Other events</span></label>
        </div>
      </fieldset>
      <button type="submit" class="btn-accent" id="prefs-save">
        <span id="prefs-save-label">Save my interests</span>
        <img src="images/icons/arrow-up-right-light.svg" width="19" height="19" alt="">
      </button>
      <p class="list-form-status" id="prefs-status" role="status"></p>
    </form>
    <p class="list-status-note">Want to stop hearing from us altogether? <a class="list-text-link" href="unsubscribe.html">Unsubscribe instead</a>.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="list-status" data-view="error" hidden>
    <p class="section-label">Your Salem list</p>
    <h1 class="list-status-heading" tabindex="-1">We couldn’t load your preferences.</h1>
    <p class="list-status-lede" id="load-error-copy" role="alert"></p>
    <div class="list-status-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn-accent" id="prefs-retry">
        Try again
        <img src="images/icons/arrow-up-right-light.svg" width="19" height="19" alt="">
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="list-status" data-view="missing" hidden>
    <p class="section-label">Link not recognized</p>
    <h1 class="list-status-heading" tabindex="-1">We couldn’t find that link.</h1>
    <p class="list-status-lede">It may be incomplete, or it may be from before you last signed up. Each signup gets a fresh link.</p>
    <p class="list-status-copy">Enter your email and we’ll send you a new link to update your interests or unsubscribe.</p>
      <form class="list-resend" data-resend-form novalidate>
        <div class="form-field">
          <label for="resend-email">Email address</label>
          <input class="field-input" type="email" id="resend-email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required aria-describedby="resend-status">
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="btn-accent">
          Email me a fresh link
          <img src="images/icons/arrow-up-right-light.svg" width="19" height="19" alt="">
        </button>
        <p class="list-form-status" id="resend-status" role="status"></p>
      </form>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const token = SalemList.takeToken(); // also removes ?token= from the address bar
  const form = document.getElementById("prefs-form");
  const saveButton = document.getElementById("prefs-save");
  const saveLabel = document.getElementById("prefs-save-label");
  const status = document.getElementById("prefs-status");
  const boxes = form.querySelectorAll('input[name="interest"]');

  function show(view, moveFocus) {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-view]").forEach(function (el) {
      el.hidden = el.dataset.view !== view;
    });
    if (moveFocus) document.querySelector('[data-view="' + view + '"] .list-status-heading').focus();
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-resend-form]").forEach(SalemList.bindResendForm);

  function load() {
    show("loading");
    SalemList.getPreferences(token).then(function (res) {
      if (res.ok && res.status === "found") {
        const chosen = (res.interests || []).map(function (x) { return String(x).toLowerCase(); });
        boxes.forEach(function (box) { box.checked = chosen.indexOf(box.value.toLowerCase()) !== -1; });
        const name = (res.firstName || "").trim();
        document.getElementById("prefs-heading").textContent = name ? "Hi, " + name + "." : "Update your interests.";
        show("edit", true);
      } else if (res.ok && res.status === "not_found") {
        SalemList.remember("token", null);
        show("missing", true);
      } else {
        document.getElementById("load-error-copy").textContent = SalemList.errorMessage(res);
        show("error", true);
      }
    });
  }

  document.getElementById("prefs-retry").addEventListener("click", load);

  form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const interests = Array.from(boxes).filter(function (b) { return b.checked; }).map(function (b) { return b.value; });

    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveLabel.textContent = "Saving…";
    status.setAttribute("role", "status");
    status.dataset.tone = "info";
    status.textContent = "Saving your interests…";

    SalemList.updateInterests(token, interests).then(function (res) {
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveLabel.textContent = "Save my interests";
      if (res.ok && res.status === "updated") {
        status.textContent = interests.length
          ? "Saved. We’ll keep you posted on what you picked."
          : "Saved. You’re still on the list for general Salem news.";
      } else if (res.ok && res.status === "not_found") {
        SalemList.remember("token", null);
        show("missing", true);
      } else {
        status.dataset.tone = "error";
        status.setAttribute("role", "alert");
        status.textContent = SalemList.errorMessage(res);
      }
    });
  });

  if (!token) show("missing");
  else load();
});
</script>
```
